name: voicekhata-monorepo
description: Voice-first multilingual bookkeeping, ledger, and inventory copilot for Indian small businesses

scripts.build:libs: npm run build --workspace=@voicekhata/shared && npm run build --workspace=@voicekhata/db
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build --workspace=@voicekhata/api && npm run build --workspace=@voicekhata/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:libs && npm run typecheck --workspace=@voicekhata/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@voicekhata/db && npm run typecheck --workspace=@voicekhata/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@voicekhata/web
